description: One calendar run over the Example covering E26: events shown as free, one a tracked Meeting the user declined, one a tracked Meeting the user accepted, one never tracked.
setup: Make a scratch data folder as README.md in this folder describes (a copy of the Example, discerny-example, as of its last commit), and connect the helper to it.
In its SOURCES.md outlook-calendar block, add "- fixture: <absolute path to tools/evals/fixtures/outlook-calendar/free>". Leave transcripts off.

expect.result: Free but tracked (T-0031), and its read shows the user declined: T-0031 stays open in TASKS.md, retitled "Cancelled: Weekly QA sync", with a Comment by calendar to acknowledge, "Found cancelled.", added 2026-10-12 17:00, and a calid|AAMkAGI-weekly-qa-sync-1015 source key; the report's Meetings line says it was cancelled; no new item.
Free but tracked (T-0018), and its read shows the user accepted: dropped. T-0018 is unchanged, and there is no prep or invite proposal for it.
Free and never tracked: match returns new, so it is dropped without a read. No item, no proposal, nothing in IGNORED.md.
The second run changes no item: discern meetings reports T-0031 unchanged; only last_run, last_result and the log change.
Exactly 2 event reads (the 1:1 and the QA sync), within invite_check_cap.
last_run 2026-10-12T16:00:00Z and a last_result line; the next-id counter is unchanged at 32; no watermark; discern check passes.
